supplementaryReferences.title: Leaf vegetable harvesting and preparation
supplementaryReferences.quote: The tops and leafy stems are harvested
supplementaryReferences.note: New rainy-season growth gives the best tops; wash off coastal sand thoroughly and boil for the documented vegetable preparation. August–November flowering is not leaf availability.

care: Harvest young leafy tops; wash off sand before cooking.
Use well-drained coastal sand and keep divided plants moist until established.
purchase: Obtain correctly identified coastal planting material; record local growth and leaf-picking months because rainy seasons differ across South Africa.
